forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {貪|むさぼ}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To eat or consume something ravenously, without restraint.
To seek or indulge in something excessively, driven by desire or greed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}り{食|く}う。
⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|す}かせた{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}り{食|く}った。
examples.english: The hungry children devoured the bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧だった⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}るよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Being starved, he ate the food in front of him as if devouring it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧。
examples.english: A politician who greedily pursues power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私腹|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}り、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He greedily lined his own pockets and embezzled company funds.

notes:
A literary and strongly negative verb conveying greed and excess. Carries a tone of moral criticism — the subject is driven by insatiable desire. Common in both written prose and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貪|むさぼ}り{食|く}う: to devour, to eat ravenously
- ⟦{富|とみ}→富：12321_tomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る: to covet wealth
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る: to greedily seek power
- {私腹|しふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る: to line one's own pockets
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る: to sleep indulgently
- ⟦{快楽|かいらく}→快楽：27770_kairaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貪|むさぼ}る: to indulge in pleasure

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Carries strong negative connotations of greed and excess. In everyday speech, ⟦がつがつ→がつがつ：05936_gatsugatsu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat greedily) is more natural for the eating sense.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がつがつ→がつがつ：05936_gatsugatsu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat greedily (casual, less literary)
- ⟦{欲張|よくば}る→欲張る：15774_yokubaru⟧: to be greedy (more colloquial)
- ⟦{渇望|かつぼう}→渇望：05999_katsubou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to crave, to thirst for (formal, but less negative than {貪|むさぼ}る)
